pin_regs.reason: the RTL registers every pin: input pin flops *_r (flop-first, no reset), every output o_* from the registered output stage; rst_c from the ot_rst_relay flop; o_bus0 is the constant zero sum-bus head word

structural_change: OWN-IDXSCORE 2026-10-18: W glue column of the wires-only IDX quarter scorer (landed-regions standard: the 1.12 x 2.25 mm quarter is dissolved into the die, not hardened with one tree). Input pin flops + W glue (key line split, valid/keep lanes, meta input, W fault cause) + registered output stage (+1 edge on every leaf input) + reset relay. Height = the two leaf rows (2 x 561.6); E face feeds leaf (0,0) and (1,0) W faces.
